services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Discover our humanitarian actions and certified training programs.

secourisme.subtitle: Certified Training Program
secourisme.title: First Aid & CPR Training
secourisme.desc: PSE1/PSE2 first aid and cardiopulmonary resuscitation training sessions, supervised by certified trainers. Recognized certification with competence tracking by our integrated Nexus-AID AI system.

catastrophes.subtitle: NDRT/RDRT Teams Deployed
catastrophes.title: Natural Disaster Intervention
catastrophes.desc: Coordination of emergency operations during natural disasters — floods, earthquakes, fires. Rapid deployment of NDRT teams with centralized management via the Nexus-AID virtual crisis room.

sang.subtitle: Regular Blood Drives Across Tunisia
sang.title: Blood Donation Campaigns
sang.desc: Organization of blood donation campaigns in partnership with blood transfusion centers. Tracking blood stocks, planning collections, and raising public awareness of the importance of blood donation.

aide.subtitle: Support for Vulnerable Populations
aide.title: Humanitarian & Social Aid
aide.desc: Distribution of food parcels, blankets, and essential items to families in precarious situations. Personalized social support and beneficiary follow-up via the Nexus-AID management system.

news.title: Latest News
news.subtitle: Follow our news, updates, and official publications.

caravane.title: Medical & Health Caravans
caravane.desc: Operational guide of the TRC mobile medical caravans offering free consultations in rural areas.
caravane.fullText: Operational guide of the TRC mobile medical caravans offering free consultations in rural areas. Includes deployment protocols, certified medical equipment management, and field reports by general practitioners and nurses. This 50-page document details community awareness strategies.

jeunesse.title: Youth & Volunteering Program
jeunesse.desc: Document detailing the TRC youth program activities: training camps, community awareness actions, and youth volunteer citizen engagement across the 24 regional committees.
jeunesse.fullText: Comprehensive document detailing the TRC youth program activities: training camps, community awareness actions, prevention campaigns, and citizen engagement of young volunteers across the 24 regional committees. Includes evaluation results and outlook for 2025.

urgence-jendouba.title: Rescue Operation in Jendouba
urgence-jendouba.desc: Successful mobilization of 120 volunteers in less than 2 hours during the floods, thanks to the Nexus-AID early warning system.
urgence-jendouba.fullText: Following heavy rains that affected the Jendouba region, the TRC mobilized 120 volunteers in less than 2 hours using the Nexus-AID early warning system. NDRT teams were deployed to 8 affected areas, evacuating 340 families and distributing emergency kits.

don-sang-tunis.title: Blood Donation Campaign — Tunis
don-sang-tunis.desc: Major blood collection campaign organized in 12 points of the Tunis governorate. Goal: 500 bags in 3 days.
don-sang-tunis.fullText: The TRC is organizing a major blood collection campaign in 12 points of the Tunis governorate from February 25 to 27, 2026. Goal: 500 bags in 3 days. Mobile units will be deployed in universities, shopping centers, and public squares. Each donor receives an awareness kit and a digital certificate via Nexus-AID.
